caption: Probability that ECI wage growth is in its high-wage-inflation state from a 2-state HMM. The model is fit on the 72 in-sample quarters only and each quarter's value uses data up to that quarter (forward filter). This series is NOT in the tournament: a traded regime signal needs at least 100 in-sample observations and ECI has 72. The high state covers 63% of quarters. Shaded bands mark NBER recessions.
narrative_alignment_note: Causal diagnostic HMM (IS-only fit, forward filter); stated as not traded.
